prompt.es: Escribe la noticia breve del recuadro: titular, lead, dos fuentes, cita y cautela.

answer.text: School science fair raises 950 euros for charity. More than 240 people visited the school science fair on Saturday, and the event raised 950 euros for charity, the organiser, Ana Ruiz, said. According to the head teacher, Mr Perez, the turnout was higher than last year. The final figure is expected to be confirmed on Monday, because some tickets were sold online. Pupils showed their experiments in the main hall, and visitors could vote for their favourite project. "It was a really good day," said one pupil. Some parents say the prices of the snacks were high, but the organiser denies it. Another fair is expected to take place next year, according to the school. The money will go to a local charity that helps young people with their studies.

Science fair helps local charity. About 240 visitors came to the school science fair last Saturday, and it raised 950 euros for charity, the organiser Ana Ruiz told the school paper.
